text: Reminder: your annual check-up is confirmed for Thursday at 3 PM at Bayview Clinic, 40 Harbor Road, Portland. Please arrive ten minutes early. — Front desk team
Appointment reminder: your tire rotation at Cedar Grove Auto is set for Monday, 9 AM. Payment plans available through FlexPay. Reply YES to confirm. — Service department
Friendly reminder: your allergy follow-up is booked for Friday, March 14 at 10 AM. The clinic shuts early during Winter Solstice week. — Nursing staff
Quick reminder: your lease review lands in the first week of May. We will go over the bill of charges and any grace period terms. — Building management
Appointment alert: the hygienist will see you Tuesday at 8 AM. Please check in with the receptionist; the dentist may join briefly. — Patient coordination

Second notice: your passport appointment is this Wednesday at 11 AM, Room 12, Central Library, 5 Maple Avenue. The entrance on Bridge Street is closed for repairs, so use the side door near the parking deck. — City services office

Service reminder: your software demo with the Atlas team is on for 2 PM Thursday. We will run through the Orion dashboard and the new Beacon reporting module; bring your laptop with Excel installed. — Customer success group

Final reminder: your immigration consultation is Monday, September 8 at 9:30 AM. If Labor Day weekend travel delays you, the paralegal can reschedule to Thursday the same week. The office is closed for the Fall Harvest break. — Legal intake desk

Quick note about your garden consult: we will meet at the greenhouse to look at the rose beds and the herb border. Expect frank talk about the clay soil, and bring the bill of materials so the estimate fits your grant budget. — Grounds crew

Scheduling change: the inspector shifted your walkthrough to 3 PM. The seller and their agent will attend, and our contractor can stay late if the appraiser needs extra time inside. Confirm with the receptionist, please. — Brokerage office

Visa interview confirmed: Thursday, October 9 at 8:45 AM, Consulate Annex, 220 Riverside Drive, Chicago. Arrive by 8:15 for screening at the North Gate; the waiting area is in the East Wing. Parking near Harbor Lane is scarce, so the Union Station shuttle is easier. — Consular desk

Your onboarding session with the Northwind Logistics IT crew starts Wednesday at 10 AM. We will set up your workstation, install Teams and the Zephyr tracking client, and walk you through the Meridian portal. If you already use Outlook, bring your login; the help desk can migrate your old mail from Gmail. — IT onboarding team

Dental reminder: your cleaning is booked for Tuesday, November 18 at 1 PM. The office closes at noon on Thanksgiving Eve and reopens the Monday after, so if a winter storm hits, the scheduler can move you to Friday morning. December slots fill fast before the Winter Break, so respond soon. — Dental care team

A note about your jewelry appraisal: the appraiser will examine the sterling silver set and the pearl necklace on Friday. We will also check the mark on the jade bracelet, and you should expect a frank assessment of the ruby ring's value. Payment is due after the invoice is issued. — Estate office

Home visit notice: the nurse will arrive between 9 and 10 AM on Thursday to check your post-surgery wound. If the caregiver is present, the nurse can review the dressing routine with them. The supervising physician will call afterward, and the pharmacist can deliver refills that day. Reply to keep this time or message the scheduler. — Visiting health team
hey, running late — meet me at the corner of Market Street and Elm, outside the bakery near Union Square. save me a spot!
btw the Zoom link for standup is broken again. just use the Slack huddle — the Notion doc has the agenda. lmk if that works
don't forget the Sprint Review on Thursday! also Monday is a holiday so no one's in. can we push the demo to Wednesday?
we will know by May if the grant came through. fingers crossed — the budget was a bit lean but the dean seemed hopeful
the barber said my stylist is off this week, so the new apprentice is taking her clients. she's supposedly really good, want me to book you too?

ok so the flight lands at Terminal 2, then the shuttle to the Old Town hostel takes like 40 mins. if you'd rather walk, cut through Riverside Park and past the cathedral — way prettier. text me when you clear customs!

ugh, the new Falcon build keeps crashing on my laptop. the IT guy says to reinstall the client and clear the Teams cache. also our Confluence page is out of date — the new hire insists on editing it in Word, which is chaos. classic

heads up — the Q3 Offsite got moved to the second week of October, right before the Harvest Festival. so the Sprint Retro is now Friday afternoon, and the big launch demo is pushed to the following Tuesday. mark your calendar!
picked up the suit from the tailor — it will be ready by June, and the fit is perfect. real sterling buttons too. they even threw in a carnation for the lapel. worth every penny imo

the landlord finally sent the plumber about the leak! he's coming Tuesday morning, and the super will let him in if you're at work. the tenant upstairs says her ceiling is fine now, so maybe just our unit. tell me if you can be there

so the conference is at the Convention Center on Lakeside Drive, but our hotel is way out by the East Gate — like a 25 min walk. there's a tram from Central Square that stops right at the Pavilion entrance though. want to grab dinner in the Old Quarter first? there's a noodle place the whole internet raves about

guess what — the Azure migration is done, but the Falcon dashboard is still pulling old data. the vendor says their API syncs overnight, and the help desk told me to just restart everything, which is obviously not the problem. meanwhile the intern works only in Sheets instead of the Beacon portal. send help

timeline update: the Atlas launch slipped a week, so the reveal is Wednesday the 15th, right after the Spring Fling. everyone's off after Memorial Day, and the planning sync moved to Tuesday. fyi, June is packed — Midterms, the Q2 All-Hands, and the Summer Solstice party all land that month

garden update: the rose bush survived the storm! also the sage and basil are thriving, and the iris bulbs finally came up. we will have herbs all summer, honestly. the only casualty was the wren nest — the wind took that branch down. at least the robin pair seems to be rebuilding nearby

big news — the recruiter emailed back! the hiring manager wants a second call, and the head of engineering might join this time. she said the interview panel was impressed, especially the take-home. the recruiter will send a slot for Thursday, and the CFO apparently asks everyone the same weird riddle, so prep for that lol
